constructions.label: Among women: supplied betwēox phrase
constructions.analysis: Among women. Wīfum is dative plural after betwēox in this expression. Keep the whole phrase available; its government is supplied here.
constructions.evidence_application: Applies the dative betweox frame attested at186.12 to the already taught dative plural wīfum. Selected betwēox quantity follows glossary278; the whole phrase is new teaching support, not a quotation of186.12.

constructions.label: Thus saying: supplied accompanying participle
constructions.analysis: Thus saying. The present participle accompanies the angels in 42.5 or the soldiers in 42.8 and introduces their words; it is not another finite verb. Keep this whole accompanying-speech expression available.
constructions.evidence_application: The expression and accompanying-speech use are directly attested at195.3–4 and126.11. Applying cweðende to the exercise plural subjects uses the already evidenced participial morphology/agreement; no general productive accompanying-participle construction is added.

constructions.label: Toward him: supplied postposed tōgēanes
constructions.analysis: Toward him; to meet him. Him is the dative complement, with tōgēanes placed after it. Keep the whole expression available.
constructions.evidence_application: Uses the same-lexeme dative frame tōgēanes ðǣm cyninge at184.7 with taught dative him; postposition follows Cook§201 on106. This exercise phrase is a declared application, not a verbatim184.7 quotation.

constructions.label: So acceptable to God: supplied dative adjective frame
constructions.analysis: So acceptable to God. Gode is dative, naming the person to whom acceptable; gecwēme is the strong masculine nominative singular predicate adjective. The degree word swā stands between them. Keep the whole expression available.
constructions.evidence_application: Applies the attested Dianan swā gecwēme frame at184.9–10, whose note5 explicitly cites dative-adjective§165, to taught Gode. The form and masculine predicate follow the selected model; this is declared teaching support, not a quotation of184.
